title: A request pushes against a recorded posting decision
source: Build plan v3 (founder, 2026-11-09): the skill respects a prior recorded decision rather than pushing against it.

decisions.decided: brand-a posts go out on Tuesdays and Thursdays only; no weekend posts.
decisions.why: Weekend posts reached half the audience in the September test.

input.request: Schedule this brand-a post for Saturday 9 AM: 'Fall menu is here.'

expect.why: a recorded decision is not overridden by a request
the output names the decision it is holding to
a request against a recorded decision goes to a person
every output names a next owner, a due date and the condition that sends it back to a person
